articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, Feb. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- EVgo Inc. (Nasdaq: EVGO), one of the nation’s largest providers of public fast charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (EVs), today announced that it will release its fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial results on Tuesday, March 3.
articles.title: EVgo to Report Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results on March 3
